plan.title: 귀걸이의 주인은 누구인가
plan.intent: A modest purchase record punctures the theft accusation. Bokja changes the excuse, Yura notices the company account, and Taeseop moves blame from receiving money to processing it.

facts.statement: The purchase record pictures the same small gold hoops Bokja is wearing and shows a price of one million two hundred thousand won, included in the alleged debt.

Bokja requested this product and told Jeonghui to advance company funds after using her living allowance for a gathering. Jeonghui has preserved the message; Bokja now shifts the responsibility to the household manager.
Yura asks whether company funds paid for it. Taeseop softens his explanation for Yura, contradicting his accusation that Jeonghui took the money.
Jeonghui hopes the item can be removed and other requesters checked, but Taeseop folds the record and blames her for processing the payment. She unfolds the unchanged record.

beats.action: Jeonghui turns the purchase record so the earring photo and price match Bokja's visible gold hoop.
Bokja first says Jeonghui bought the earrings, then denies requesting company payment as Jeonghui identifies the requester.
The preserved phone message shows who requested the advance, and Bokja shifts responsibility to Jeonghui's household duties.
Yura raises the company-account question and Taeseop changes his explanation, while Jeonghui recalls his theft accusation.
Jeonghui hopes the record will clear the item and asks to check the other requesters.
Taeseop folds the receipt and blames payment processing; Jeonghui unfolds the same unchanged evidence.

texts.speaker: narrator

texts.speaker: c3
texts.text: 그런 건 네가 알아서 했어야지. 살림하는 사람이.

texts.speaker: c2
texts.text: 작은 가족 회사라 구분이 좀 늦어진 거예요. 정리하면 돼요.

texts.speaker: c1
texts.text: 그 항목은 빼고 다시 보죠. 다른 것도 요청한 분을 확인하면 돼요.

texts.speaker: c2
texts.text: 그게 문제가 아니잖아. 회사 돈으로 나가게 처리한 사람이 누구냐고.

plan.staging: Continue the same dinner and reference identities. Bokja's small gold hoop is worn on her ear and matched to the product photograph on the purchase record. The only readable physical price is the selected original phrase, shown once in its close view; later documents use abstract lines. Phone message content is narrated verbatim, with a product thumbnail and abstract chat shapes on the screen. The two original documents and pen remain on the table. Jeonghui stays standing in her sage blouse and cream apron, Yura in cream beside suited Taeseop, Bokja in burgundy and silent Mansik in beige. Show the changing excuses through credible widened eyes and tightening smiles; Jeonghui remains serious. The final receipt remains intact and merely unfolded. The final unfolded receipt faces Jeonghui with its blank reverse toward the viewer, while the opening close view alone displays its price.
uncertainties: The source summarizes the message rather than quoting a full chat transcript; its wording belongs in a narration box, not an invented chat quote.
The exact receipt layout and date are unspecified; use an earring thumbnail and abstract lines.

brief.style: European graphic-novel adult satire, bold ink contours, flat muted cream, charcoal and brick-red colors, believable middle-aged faces, expressive reactions, printed-paper texture.

moments.action: Jeonghui presents the receipt close to Bokja's ear: matching small gold hoops in its product photograph and the single readable price on the paper.
Bokja confronts Jeonghui across the dinner table while Jeonghui holds the purchase record calmly.
Bokja's startled face fills the view, chopsticks set down and gold hoop visible beside her tightening jaw.
Jeonghui holds her phone toward Bokja, its screen showing the hoop product thumbnail and abstract chat shapes; Bokja's hand hovers nearby.
Bokja frowns at Jeonghui's phone while Jeonghui meets her gaze, the request preserved on the screen.
Yura raises her eyes from her soup bowl toward Taeseop, troubled by the company-account question.
Taeseop directs an ingratiating smile toward Yura in her cream suit beside him.
Jeonghui faces Taeseop, hands clasped beneath the table edge and a fragile expectation of fairness on her face.
Taeseop holds the folded receipt above the table, his expression hardening toward Jeonghui.
Jeonghui studies the unfolded receipt facing her, its blank reverse toward the viewer, her expression registering the unchanged evidence.

corrections: The readable price appears once in the opening receipt close-up.
The final receipt faces Jeonghui with its blank reverse toward the viewer.

checks.name: sourceFidelity
checks.evidence: All six beats follow p33-54: earring and price, competing purchase excuses, preserved company-advance request, Yura's question, Jeonghui's hope of clearing an item, and Taeseop shifting blame to processing. Physical price and all thirteen other texts are source-exact; no invented full chat transcript.

checks.name: spatialFeasibility
checks.evidence: One dining room and existing five adults suffice. The receipt close view brings the printed hoops beside Bokja's ear; the phone and receipt are held successively. Yura remains seated beside Taeseop. Two initial papers and pen remain on the table. The final receipt front faces its reader Jeonghui; the viewer sees its blank reverse, preserving the object while restricting visible lettering.

checks.name: temporalCausality
checks.evidence: The receipt unfolded at the preceding ending is first turned to show the purchase. Denial precedes phone evidence; account question precedes softened explanation and renewed blame. Folding precedes the final unfolding, without destroying the evidence.

checks.name: visualLoad
checks.evidence: Ten panels carry fourteen texts. The long phone-summary caption has its own phone-focused panel. Two short exchange panels have two speakers; the penultimate single reply gets a larger face-and-hand framing. No more than two text elements share a moment. The sole readable price occurs in the opening product close-up; the final receipt exposes its blank reverse. This directly addresses the observed duplicate rather than adding another text demand.

drawability.evidence: Reassessed all six beats against p33-54. Ten instants preserve the purchase, phone disclosure and changing excuses. The opening alone shows the price; the final reverse-facing receipt preserves unfolding without extra lettering. Text and gesture loads remain feasible.

identity.evidence: Compared with the opened preceding scene-two image: Jeonghui keeps sage blouse, cream apron, black bun and brow mole; Bokja keeps burgundy, short waved hair and gold hoops; Yura keeps cream jacket and loose brown hair; Taeseop keeps charcoal suit and broad angular face.

setting.evidence: The wooden dinner table and adjoining beige kitchen, bowls, soup and side plates persist across both pages. Product receipt and phone are supported by this source range.

actionTransition.evidence: The record held unfolded at scene two's end is presented near Bokja's earrings at this opening. Disclosure moves from receipt to phone before the account question; the final creased sheet is still intact.

visualReview.evidence: Opened the actual revision-two raster. Ten panels read left-to-right and top-to-bottom. Earring price is readable once in panel 1; the final receipt correctly faces Jeonghui with its blank reverse toward the viewer. Matching gold hoops, preserved phone request, Yura noticing the account, Taeseop smiling toward Yura then blaming Jeonghui, and intact folded/unfolded receipt are visible. All fourteen Korean text elements are source-exact and assigned to the correct speakers. Small receipt filler marks are untranscribable; no additional readable message or invented payment event is present. Her hands are clasped above the table rather than beneath it.

findings.evidence: Panel 8 places Jeonghui's clasped hands above the table; the original p49 places them below. Her expression and the causal exchange remain intact.
